newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's Hotung placement subscribed 10 times.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Hotung placement subscribed 10 times.

text.p: Taiwan's Hotung Investment Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its placement tranche of 193.9 million shares was over 10 times subscribed.
Venture capital investment group Hotung said on Monday it was offering a total of 242.4 million shares at US$0.26 each in its Singapore initial public offer.
The offer comprises the placement tranche of 193.9 million shares and a public tranche of 48.5 million shares.
The company is raising net proceeds of about US$41.86 million. The shares are to be quoted on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
